services.name: Plaster crack repair
services.blurb: Loose plaster pinned back to the lath, cracks taped and skimmed so they stop coming back.

services.name: Plaster to drywall
services.blurb: Failing plaster walls replaced with board, trim and window casings kept and reset.

services.name: Skim coat over old plaster
services.blurb: Bumpy, patched plaster ceilings skimmed flat without tearing them out or filling the house with dust.

services.name: Nail pops and seam cracks
services.blurb: Winter nail pops and tape cracks reset, refinished and primed in one tidy visit.

services.name: Water-stained ceilings
services.blurb: Ice dam and leak stains opened, dried, rebuilt and sealed so they never bleed through.

services.name: Patch repair
services.blurb: Holes from old wiring, pipes and doorknobs filled and blended into wall or ceiling.

services.name: New drywall and finishing
services.blurb: Additions, attic rooms and basements hung, taped and finished to a smooth, paint-ready wall.

services.name: Arches and curved walls
services.blurb: Old plaster archways repaired or rebuilt in board with a clean, even curve.

services.name: Popcorn ceiling removal
services.blurb: Ceilings tested first, then scraped, skimmed and primed into a flat white finish.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our North End Victorian has the original horsehair plaster and a ceiling crack that ran the length of the parlor. Theo pinned it with plaster washers, taped it and skimmed it. Two winters and it has not reopened.
reviews.name: Claire B.

reviews.text: We were sure we needed to gut the West Side bedrooms. They showed us which walls were still keyed to the lath and only replaced the two that were not. Saved the old door casings too.
reviews.name: Ray O.

reviews.text: Every January the hallway in our Bedford colonial gets little bumps along the screws. They reset the screws, refinished and primed it all in one morning.
reviews.name: Hannah J.

reviews.text: Ice dam stain over the kitchen table in our cape. They cut the wet section, let it dry with a fan for a day, then finished it. The primer they used kept the brown from coming back.
reviews.name: Pete S.

reviews.text: Turned the attic of our 1950s house into a bedroom for our daughter. Knee walls, a sloped ceiling and a dormer, all finished smooth. Clean job site every afternoon.
reviews.name: Lucia F.

reviews.text: The living room ceiling was a patchwork of three old repairs. One skim coat later it looks like one ceiling again, and they covered every piece of furniture first.
reviews.name: Ken W.

reviews.text: Old knob-and-tube had been pulled out by the electrician and left a dozen holes. They filled every one and you would not know.
reviews.name: Dina R.

proof.guarantee: If a crack we repaired reopens within two heating seasons, we come back and fix it.

prices.note: per room, pinned, taped and skimmed
